elements.description: Review an AI's word-level edits to prose: accept or reject each change in place.

properties.name: original
properties.description: The text as it is now

properties.name: changes
properties.description: Pre-computed segments instead of original + suggested

properties.name: decisions
properties.description:
The verdicts so far. Changed by the user unless a tc-decisions-change listener calls preventDefault(); new text
resets them (reported as {})

properties.name: label
properties.description: Small line above the card (Clean: at the top of the card), e.g. "Suggested by AI · Make it shorter"

properties.name: fill
properties.description: Grow to the container's height: the card fills the rest below the label, the toolbar staying in place

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-decisions-change
events.description: A decision, undo or reset, or new text starting over ({ decisions: InlineDiffDecisions }); cancelable

events.name: tc-text-change
events.description: Every decision (and undo), with the text so far ({ text: string }) – pending changes keep the original words

events.name: tc-done
events.description: No change is pending any more ({ text: string }, the final text)

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Shows the popover on a change (by its index among the changes) without moving focus; null hides it

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Restores the last decision (or the last "all" batch)

functions.name: diffWords
functions.signature: diffWords(original: string, suggested: string, maxCells: number): DiffSegment[]
functions.description:
Word-level diff of two texts (Myers' shortest edit script over word and whitespace tokens), grouped into equal
runs and changes. `maxCells` caps the work – tokens in the part between the common start and end, times the
edits needed; past it the middle becomes one replacement.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every decision (and undo) with the text so far – pending changes keep the original words

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called once no change is pending, with the final text

props.name: decisions
props.description:
The verdicts so far (controlled). New text resets them: an uncontrolled diff starts over, a controlled one
reports `{}` through onDecisionsChange

props.name: defaultDecisions
props.description: The verdicts to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onDecisionsChange
props.description: Every decision, undo and reset, with all verdicts so far

props.name: ref
props.description: The imperative handle (the element implements it)

changelog: inline-diff: `diffWords` uses Myers' O(ND) diff instead of a capped LCS table. Long texts stay word by word (a 3,000-word text with 150 edits gives 150 changes, where anything over ~1,500 words used to become one replacement), and the work grows with the edits, not the length squared. Its third argument is now a work budget (tokens × edits); past it the middle is still one replacement.
